title: Trajectory Forcing: Exploiting Diffusion Trajectories for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
title_zh: Trajectory Forcing：利用扩散轨迹进行自回归长视频生成

paragraphs.en: TraF利用先前片段的去噪轨迹作为上下文，提升自回归扩散长视频生成的质量与时长扩展能力。 Autoregressive (AR) modeling is arguably the only way to extend a fixed-length video diffusion model to longer or even streaming videos. However, existing AR diffusion methods use only the previously predicted chunk as context for the next, discarding the intermediate predictions that constitute the chunk's generation history. In contrast, conventional AR models such as LLMs condition on the entire history of preceding tokens. To this end, we propose Trajectory Forcing (TraF), an AR diffusion method that exploits the denoising trajectories of previous video chunks as context. TraF operates under two training regimes: (1) with ground-truth videos, where pseudo-trajectories are constructed from Gaussian interpolations and re-predicted by the model, and (2) with a teacher model, where real trajectories are obtained from the student's own denoising rollout. The first regime naturally provides a strong initialization for the second. On the 5-second VBench benchmark, TraF achieves a Total score of 85.15, outperforming Self Forcing (+0.84) and Causal Forcing (+1.11), with Quality and Semantic improving simultaneously. On 30-second generation---6$\times$ the training horizon---TraF achieves the highest overall quality among all compared methods.
paragraphs.zh: TraF利用先前片段的去噪轨迹作为上下文，提升自回归扩散长视频生成的质量与时长扩展能力。自回归（AR）建模可以说是将固定时长视频扩散模型扩展到更长甚至流式视频的唯一途径。 然而，现有的AR扩散方法仅将先前预测的片段作为下一段的上下文，丢弃了构成该片段生成历史的中间预测。 相比之下，诸如大语言模型（LLM）之类的传统AR模型则以前面全部token历史为条件。 为此，我们提出轨迹强制（Trajectory Forcing，TraF），这是一种利用先前视频片段的去噪轨迹作为上下文的AR扩散方法。 TraF在两种训练模式下运行：（1）使用真实视频时，通过高斯插值构造伪轨迹并由模型重新预测；（2）使用教师模型时，从学生自身的去噪展开中获得真实轨迹。 第一种模式自然地为第二种模式提供了良好的初始化。 在5秒的VBench基准上，TraF取得了85.15的总分，优于Self Forcing（+0.84）和Causal Forcing（+1.11），且质量与语义得分同时提升。 在30秒生成任务上——即训练时长的6倍——TraF在所有对比方法中取得了最高的整体质量。
